nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows CFO lattice planes (400, 331) and CoBDC (011) in the precatalyst; reconstructed CFO@CoBDC/MCV shows well-defined crystallinity of gamma-CoOOH and alpha-Co(OH)2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HRTEM (Figure 1c) ... (400) and (331) planes of CFO ... blue region (Figures 1e and 1f) ... (011) crystal plane of CoBDC ... CFO@CoBDC/MCV exhibits well-defined crystallization ... (015) and (018) crystal planes of gamma -CoOOH and (012) plane of alpha -Co(OH) 2

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD identifies phases of CFO, CoBDC, and reconstructed phases including gamma-CoOOH and alpha-Co(OH)2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray powder diffraction (XRD) patterns show that all peaks in CFO@CoBDC belong to the CFO and CoBDC ... intensity of the (012) plane belonging to CFO@CoBDC/MCV is much stronger

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS shows an increased Co2+ proportion (43.28%) and higher oxygen vacancy ratio (Ov/Co-O = 2.542) for the sample reconstructed under a magnetic field.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the Co 2p spectra ... the Co 2+ proportion increases from 33.49% (CFO@CoBDC/CV) to 43.28% (CFO@CoBDC/MCV) ... value increases to 2.542 for CFO@CoBDC/MCV

nodes.characterization_summary: EPR shows a stronger peak at g=2.003 for CFO@CoBDC/MCV, indicating higher oxygen vacancy concentration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: CFO@CoBDC/MCV displays a stronger peak intensity with a g -factor of 2.003 compared to CFO@CoBDC/CV.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman shows bands at 497 and 578 cm-1 (CoOOH) and a F2g band (~620 cm-1) representing Co2+ species.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 3f shows two Raman peaks at around 497 and 578 cm-1 , corresponding to Eg and Alg vibrational modes of Co-O of CoOOH ... F2g band maintains a relatively high strength ... indicating more divalent Co hydroxide

nodes.characterization_summary: Hysteresis loops show CFO@CoBDC retains ferromagnetism with reduced saturation magnetization compared to pure CFO (52 emu/g).
nodes.evidence_snippet: After wrapping by CoBDC, the saturation magnetization is significantly reduced; however, the original ferromagnetism is still retained for CFO@CoBDC (Figure 1i).

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS demonstrates reduced charge transfer resistance (Rct) for CFO@CoBDC/MCV, indicating enhanced interfacial reaction kinetics.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) demonstrates the enhanced interfacial reaction kinetics after magnetic activation ... CFO@CoBDC/MCV shows a reduced charge transfer resistance (R ct)

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance (Cdl) values are similar for all samples, indicating performance enhancement is due to intrinsic activity rather than ECSA.
nodes.evidence_snippet: double-layer capacitance (C dl ) is calculated by CV tests ... these samples possess similar C dl values, implying that the performance enhancement in CFO@CoBDC/MCV is not due to a larger ECSA
